༄༅/ /myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i gtor chog bsdus pa bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i gtor chog bsdus pa bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gtor ma byin rlabs yi dam ltar byas la/ rang gi mdun du pad nyi la hūṃ las myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa sku mdog mthing nag dang po gnyis gri thod/ bar ba gnyis mi mgo'i 'phreng ba dang rtse gsum/ tha ma gnyis ḍa ma ru zhags pa bsnams pa/ stag lbags dang mgo 'phreng rus pa dang sbrul dang phyag zhabs thams cad la dril bu g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba'i brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pas tshogs kyi bdag po mnan pa/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs sma ra smin ma dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ sin nghu ra'i thig le dpral bar byug pa/ tsandan gyi sdong po la rgyab brten pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / de'i g.yon du bhyoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo nag mo dre'u la bzhon pa khram shing dang nad rkyal thogs pa/ mdun du gnod sbyin kṣe ṭa pa la smug nag gri thod 'dzin pa/ dom nag snyon pa la bzhon pa/ g.yas su dzi na mi tra dmar nag cang te'u dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu ṭakki ra dza nag po spu gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yon du bdud mgon trakshad rus mtshon dang thod snying 'dzin pa/ bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber dang sag lham gsol ba/ de'i phyi rol du dpal mgon bdud cu rtsa lnga dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal tsandan gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung na myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ steng na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ g.yas na dpa' bo ngar dang bcas shing*/ g.yon na dpa' mo 'dzum dang bcas pa bka' sdod zhing skyong pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa/ o badzra mahā kā la sa pā ri wa ra kṣeṃ nyer gcig / badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ

nang mchod byin rlabs bya/ oṃ badzra ma hā ka la ༵kṣeṃ kṣe ṭa pa la bighnan bi ya ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces mang du bzla/ sngags de ka'i mthar/ i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ bhyoḥm mo nag mo be ta li sindhi ku lu ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ e dam sogs lan gsum/ oṃ kṣe ṭa pa la bighnan hūṃ phaṭa/ i dam sogs lan gsum/ oṃ dzi na mi tra ba shing ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ i dam sogs gsum/ oṃ ṭakki ra dza sa mā ya bhyoḥdu dza hūṃ phaṭa/ i dam sogs gsum/ oṃ du yag dza mahā kā la trakshad hūṃ phaṭa/ i dam sogs lan gsum/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya shā sa na= sogs/ di na me ke na mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ i dam sogs lan gsum gyis dam can spyi la 'bul/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes nang mchod 'bul/ hūṃ/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhabs gdub dang bcas bi na ya ka mnan/ /nag po chen po stag gi sham thams can/ /phyag drug sbrul gyis rgyan gyi rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas pas gri gug bar bas 'phreng ba 'dzin/ /tha ma ḍa ma ru ni drag tu 'khrol/ / g.yon pa thod khrag dang ni mdung rtse gsum/ /de bzhin zhags pa bzung nas 'ching bar byed/ /drag po zhal gdang mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ /spyan gsum drag po'i dbu skra gyen du brdzes/ /dpral bar sindhu ra yis thig legs par byugs/ /spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab brtan/ khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /shing las byon nas gtor ma len mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan phyag drug pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la= sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btabs/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med pa'i grib sel la sogs pa'i rjes su 'di rnams byas kyang rung*/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ smon lam dang bkra shis brjod do/ /phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i gtor chog bsdus pa khyer bde 'di ni gangs dkar rdo rje gdan gyi gnyer nyi ma rnam rgyal gyis bskur ngor/

tā ra nā thas pho brang gangs dkar du sbyar ba'o// //bya ba gang brtsam chos dang mthun nas kyang*/ /sdig las gang gis nyams pa med bzhin du/ /rnam dkar dri ma med pa'i legs lam la/ / skye 'dir dge rtsa 'bad tshad der 'gyur shog/// - PAGE 158 -- PAGE 159 -- PAGE 157 -
